lines.en: label iospring6:
scene noonsky
It’s been kind of a while since I’ve just aimlessly wandered around the part of the city where Io’s bathhouse is.
lines.zh: 我已经有段时间没有在 Io 的澡堂所在的这一带漫无目的地闲逛了。

lines.en: {size=-4}And the reason I mention that now is that, upon coming here with the specific goal in mind of meeting {i}up{/i} with Io, I realized that I was once again neglecting this apparent hidden desire of mine to just sort of wander around and do nothing.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}而我之所以现在提起这个，是因为当我抱着专门来{i}见{/i} Io 这个目的来到这里时，我意识到自己又一次压抑了那个明显的隐秘欲望——只是随便四处走走、什么也不做。{/size}

lines.en: {size=-3}You’d think that being essentially unemployed now would be conducive to that and, to some extent, I’m sure you’re right. But there are choices I make every single day that do naught but detract from this and today is no exception.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}你大概会以为，如今基本处于失业状态应该有助于这件事，而且在某种程度上，你肯定是对的。但我每天都会做出一些选择，唯一的作用就是消解它，今天也不例外。{/size}

lines.en: But what if I were to forgo Io entirely and just do laps around her block instead? Counting the cracks in the sidewalk and stepping on every one so as to grind my mother’s corpse to dust.
lines.zh: 可要是我干脆完全放弃找 Io，改成绕着她家那条街区一圈圈地走呢？数着人行道上的裂缝，每一条都踩上去，好把我母亲的尸体碾成齑粉。

lines.en: Do you think the girl with green hair would notice me? And if so, how many laps would it take?
lines.zh: 你觉得那个绿头发的女孩会注意到我吗？如果会，要绕多少圈？

lines.en: If so, would she be proud of my newfound occupation as a corpse mangler?
lines.zh: 如果会，她会为我新找到的「碾尸人」这份工作感到骄傲吗？

lines.en: Have I stolen this job out from under her feet?
lines.zh: 我是不是从她脚下抢走了这份工作？

lines.en: Okay. That’s enough of that.
lines.zh: 好了。就此打住。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers1
: Oh, Sensei! Hey. Feel like it’s been a while since I’ve seen you over here.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！嘿。感觉好久没在这边见到你了。

lines.en: : What were you up to today? How’d you wind up in my neck of the woods?
lines.zh: : 你今天都忙什么呢？怎么跑到我这一带来啦？

lines.en: : Well, the initial intention was to come see you. But then I got caught up in a brief inner-monologue about corpse mutilation and started walking around in circles instead.
lines.zh: : 嗯，最初的目的是来看你。但后来我陷进了一段关于残害尸体的简短内心独白里，然后就开始绕起圈子来。

lines.en: : And then wound up here once you realized you were essentially thinking about nothing and started to feel like you were wasting your day?
lines.zh: : 然后当你意识到自己基本上什么都没在想、开始觉得自己在浪费这一天的时候，就走到这儿来了？

lines.en: : Yeah, you know how it is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你懂的。

lines.en: : Sure do. But that’s fine by me because {i}now{/i} we get to waste away together. Unless you’re here to tell me to die or something.
lines.zh: : 我当然懂。不过对我来说没关系，因为{i}现在{/i}我们能一起虚度了。除非你是来叫我死的还是怎么的。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t come all the way over here to tell you that, Io. I’d just text you.
lines.zh: : 我不会大老远跑来就为了跟你说那个，Io。我会发短信的。

lines.en: : Just one more reason to keep my phone permanently on silent then.
lines.zh: : 那又多了一个让我把手机永久静音的理由。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers2
: You’re not meeting up with anybody, are you? Because context makes me think you’re not, but I’m instinctively obligated to ask due to self-esteem issues and an unwanted phobia of abandonment.
lines.zh: : 你不是要跟谁见面吧？因为从情境来看我觉得你不是，但出于自尊方面的问题和一种多余的被遗弃恐惧症，我本能上还是非问不可。

lines.en: : I’m actually here to buy the place.
lines.zh: : 其实我是来把这里买下来的。

lines.en: : Nice. Can I get Sundays off then? It’s American football season and Sunday Night Football starts at like 8:00 AM here. I can’t watch it without being tired for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: : 不错。那我能把周日休了吗？现在是美式橄榄球赛季，这里的周日夜赛差不多早上 8 点就开播。我要是看了，接下来一整天都得犯困。

lines.en: : Graduating from baseball?
lines.zh: : 从棒球毕业了？

lines.en: : No. I just like watching people get hurt because I am a bad person. Football’s kind of boring as a sport to be honest. Way slower than baseball.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是喜欢看别人受伤，因为我是个坏人。说实话，橄榄球作为一项运动挺无聊的。比棒球慢多了。

lines.en: : Really? I always thought it was the other way around.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我一直以为是反过来的。

lines.en: : Could be if they didn’t have to stop the clock for some sort of injury every other drive. Guess that’s the price I have to pay for secondhand masochism, though.
lines.zh: : 如果他们不是每隔一轮进攻就要因为某种伤情暂停计时，也许会是那样。不过，大概这就是我为二手受虐癖要付出的代价吧。

lines.en: : Gotcha. Well, I’m out of sports-related dialogue and would like to swap conversation topics now.
lines.zh: : 明白了。嗯，我的体育相关话题已经用完了，想换个话题了。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers3
: Are you not here to use the bath today? We’re just gonna hang out?
lines.zh: : 你今天不是来泡澡的？我们就是纯粹一起待着？

lines.en: : When have I ever come here to use the bath and not talk to you?
lines.zh: : 我哪次来这儿泡澡的时候没跟你说话了？

lines.en: : All the time. Never alone, though. But I’ve always expected that to change since I can’t fathom wanting to be around Ami every hour of the day.
lines.zh: : 每次都是。不过从来没有单独过。但我一直预料到这会变，毕竟我无法想象有人愿意一天到晚每小时都跟 Ami 待在一起。

lines.en: : Oh, also, can you tell her to stop getting gay with Uta? I don’t want to keep hearing about it.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，你能不能让她别再跟 Uta 搞那些同性恋的事？我不想一直听到。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers4
: Sure, I’ll- wait, what?
lines.zh: : 当然，我——等等，什么？

lines.en: : いらっしゃいませ 。
lines.zh: : いらっしゃいませ 。 (欢迎光临。)

lines.en: : Hello, four ple- OH MY GOD!
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临，四——我的天哪！

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers5
: A MAN! THAT’S A MAN! GET HIM!
lines.zh: : 是个男的！那是个男人！抓住他！

lines.en: : Ara ara...So rare nowadays. The chances of him being single are rather slim, no?
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀……这年头可真少见。他单身的概率应该相当低吧？

lines.en: : Like I care about that! It’s been years since I’ve gotten any action! I need to jump at every single opportunity I get!
lines.zh: : 谁在乎那个啊！我已经好几年没开荤了！我得抓住每一个机会！

lines.en: : Aren’t you over-exaggerating, Akina? We see men all the time. They’re just a little more rare now that-
lines.zh: : Akina，你是不是夸张了？我们经常见到男人的啊。只是现在稍微稀有一点，因为——

lines.en: : Not HOT ones!
lines.zh: : 帅的才没有！

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, okay.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，好吧。

lines.en: : All we get are old people! And rich people who’d never sleep with a lower middle class salarywoman like me!
lines.zh: : 我们见到的全是老头！还有那种绝对不会跟我这种下层中产阶级工薪女睡的富人！

lines.en: : Quick, give him more of your back story. It might persuade him to sleep with you.
lines.zh: : 快，再多讲讲你的背景故事。说不定能说服他跟你睡。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers6

: {size=-2}Akina Ando. Twenty-nine years old. Four total partners. When I was twelve, I was hit by a motorcycle and needed to get a plate installed in my leg. My favorite foods are okonomiyaki and Pepero.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}Akina Ando。二十九岁。总共交往过四个。我十二岁的时候被摩托车撞了，腿里装了一块钢板。我最喜欢的食物是大阪烧和 Pepero。{/size}

lines.en: : No flirting in the lobby, please. Or {i}anywhere.{/i}
lines.zh: : 请不要在大厅调情。{i}哪儿都别{/i}。

lines.en: : Uhh-
: Don’t listen to her. You and me? We were meant for each other. I can {i}feel{/i} it. Now all that’s left is for me to feel {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 别听她的。你和我？我们是天造地设的一对。我能{i}感觉到{/i}。现在就剩让我好好感受{i}你{/i}一下了。

lines.en: : Give it a rest, Akina. You’re probably hitting on him in front of his little sister right now.
lines.zh: : 行了，Akina。你大概正当着他妹妹的面搭讪他呢。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers7
: Io, what do I do?
lines.zh: : Io，我该怎么办？

lines.en: : Beats me, Onii-sama. I can’t prevent you from following your heart. Just know that you will be breaking mine in the process.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，Onii-sama。我不能阻止你遵从自己的心。只是你要知道，你会在这个过程中伤透我的心。

lines.en: : Aww...I’m rooting for {i}them{/i} now. Sorry, Akina.
lines.zh: : 哇……我现在站{i}他们{/i}这边了。抱歉啦，Akina。

lines.en: : Man-meat. Look at me. Look into my eyes.
lines.zh: : 男人肉。看着我。看着我的眼睛。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers8
: {i}Man-meat?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}男人肉？{/i}

lines.en: : You. Me. Bath. And a throat so deep you could get lost in it. Sound good?
lines.zh: : 你。我。澡堂。还有一张深得能让你迷路在里面的喉咙。听着不错吧？

lines.en: : That’s...uhh...
scene iosenseiothers9
: I’m gay.
lines.zh: : 我是同性恋。

lines.en: : That’s fine. You don’t have to call me after. Just let me use your body for a little while.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你事后不用给我打电话。让我用一下你的身体就好。

lines.en: : I think that was a rejection, Akina.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是拒绝，Akina。

lines.en: : If you’re so gay, tell me what docking feels like.
lines.zh: : 你既然这么 gay，那告诉我 docking 是什么感觉。

lines.en: : Uhh...good?
lines.zh: : 呃……挺好？

lines.en: : I’m convinced. Come on, Akina. I’ll help you update your Tinder profile.
lines.zh: : 我信了。走吧，Akina。我帮你更新一下 Tinder 资料。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers10
: That’s not going to help when the bank of available men in Kumon-mi is even emptier than my lower-middle class wallet! Give me that cock, gay boy!
lines.zh: : 那有什么用，Kumon-mi 的可用男人存量比我这下层中产阶级的钱包还空！把那根鸡巴给我，基佬小子！

lines.en: : Sorry, but if you guys aren’t going to pay, I’m going to have to call the police.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过如果你们不付钱的话，我就得报警了。

lines.en: : CALL THEM! THEY MIGHT BE MEN! I’M REQUESTING A FULL CAVITY SEARCH WHEN THEY GET HERE! THERE’S A BOMB IN MY VAGINA AND ONLY A FAT COCK CAN DEFUSE IT!
lines.zh: : 报啊！他们说不定是男的！等他们来了我要申请全身腔体搜查！我阴道里有颗炸弹，只有一根粗鸡巴才能拆掉它！

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers11
: Akina! Bad girl! Come!
lines.zh: : Akina！坏女孩！过来！

lines.en: : S...Sorry about her...She gets like this whenever there’s a full moon...
lines.zh: : 抱、抱歉啊她……一到满月她就这样……

lines.en: : This should cover admission for four, right? Oh, and I have a punch card. If you could-
lines.zh: : 这些够四个人的入场费了吧？哦，我还有张集点卡。如果可以的话——

lines.en: : Not a chance.
lines.zh: : 想都别想。

lines.en: : Yeah...that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也是。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers12
scene iosenseiothers13
: So anyway, football.
lines.zh: : 那么总之，橄榄球。

lines.en: : Io, what just happened?
lines.zh: : Io，刚刚发生了什么？

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers14
: What, {i}those{/i} girls? They come here all the time and stay for hours. They were probably just surprised to see you standing there all {i}Sensei-{/i}like and stuff.
lines.zh: : 什么，{i}那些{/i}女生？她们经常来，一待就是好几个小时。她们大概只是惊讶地看到你站在那儿，一副 {i}Sensei{/i} 的样子什么的。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you didn’t follow them. They seem like what you’d call “conventionally attractive.” That one girl would probably pay you too. Even {i}with{/i} her lower-middle class salary.
lines.zh: : 我挺意外你没跟过去。她们看起来就是你会说的「常规意义上的美女」。那个女生搞不好还愿意付你钱呢。{i}哪怕{/i}以她下层中产阶级的薪水。

lines.en: : I prefer girls with character models, personally.
lines.zh: : 我个人更喜欢有角色建模的女生。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers15
: Huh. Yeah, I guess they did seem a little monochromatic now that you mention it. Am I not like that?
lines.zh: : 嗯。是啊，你这么一说，她们确实显得有点单色。我不是那样的吧？

lines.en: : No. Almost, though. You {i}are{/i} very green in most cases. And I’d say it works for you, but you’d probably just say I’m only being nice or something.
lines.zh: : 不是。不过快了。大多数情况下你都{i}非常{/i}绿。我想说这很适合你，但你大概只会说我是在哄你什么的。

lines.en: : Do you even have the moral propensity to be that nice to someone so clearly undeserving of praise? What’s your {i}real{/i} end goal here, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你对一个明显不配被夸的人，真的有足够的道德倾向去那么好吗？你{i}真正{/i}的最终目的是什么，Sensei？

lines.en: : To find a future where Io Ichimonji can be happy with herself, as unlikely as that seems.
lines.zh: : 找到一种未来，让 Io Ichimonji 能够对自己满意——尽管那看起来不太可能。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers16

: {size=-4}Aww, Sensei. It’s times like this where I wish my disdain for other females didn’t inhibit my desire to see this as a cute gesture rather than you just choosing to not follow a bunch of annoying strumpets into the women’s bath for group sex.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}哇，Sensei。就是这种时候，我真希望自己对其他女性的厌恶不会妨碍我把这当成一个可爱的举动，而不是你只是选择没跟着一群烦人的娼妇进女浴池去群交。{/size}

lines.en: : Strumpets? Are you three-hundred years old?
lines.zh: : 娼妇？你是三百岁的人吗？

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers17
: No, but it really {i}feels{/i} like I am sometimes, you know? What with all the medications, the hard candy I keep at my bedside, and the fact that I use a bow and arrow on a weekly basis.
lines.zh: : 不是，但有时候我真的{i}觉得{/i}自己是，你知道吗？毕竟有那么多的药、我床头常备的硬糖，还有我每周都要用弓箭这件事。

lines.en: : That last one seems like more of a time period thing and not something I’d associate with senior citizens. But go off, I guess.
lines.zh: : 最后那条听起来更像是时代背景的问题，我可不会把它跟老年人联系在一起。不过你继续，随便你。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers18
: Nah, I won’t subject you to that. Not after you’ve already lowered your value by approximately 50%% after kissing me.
lines.zh: : 不，我不拿这个烦你了。毕竟你亲了我之后，身价已经跌了大约 50%%。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be sticking to your regular age group instead of locking lips with your elders and expanding the dating bank?
lines.zh: : 你不是该守着自己的同龄人、而不是跟长辈亲嘴、扩大择偶库吗？

lines.en: : Age groups are for suckers and like half of my identity is built around that. What {i}really{/i} sucks is that the other half is built upon refusing and questioning it.
lines.zh: : 年龄分层是给傻子定的，而我大概有一半的自我认同就建立在这上面。{i}真正{/i}糟糕的是，另一半建立在拒绝和质疑它上面。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers19
: Lucky. I built {i}my{/i} identity around the dumpster behind the bathhouse and now I’m too sad and gross to try and change it.
lines.zh: : 真幸运。我把{i}自己{/i}的认同建立在澡堂后面那个垃圾箱上，现在我又丧又恶心，连改都懒得改了。

lines.en: : Maybe we can increase your value by kissing {i}more{/i} then?
lines.zh: : 也许我们可以{i}多{/i}亲几次来提升你的身价？

lines.en: : Are you sure you want to waste such cute lines on me when you have Uta mentally humping you all day long now? Save that stuff for her, Sensei. All {i}I{/i} need is...
lines.zh: : 你确定要把这么可爱的台词浪费在我身上吗，明明 Uta 现在整天都在脑子里跟你交配？那种话留给她吧，Sensei。{i}我{/i}需要的只是……

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers20
: Well, basically all of the attention you have for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 嗯，基本上就是你今后永远剩下的全部注意力。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers21
: But all I {i}deserve{/i} is maybe a pat on the head once a month. Or a hug every two. Whichever’s easier for you.
lines.zh: : 但我{i}配得到{/i}的，大概也就是一个月一次被摸摸头。或者两个月一次拥抱。哪个对你更省事就哪个。

lines.en: : I’ll just keep kissing you, if that’s okay. That’s the closest I’ve come to making you happy so far. Though, it remains to be seen whether that was really {i}me{/i} or just the mysterious hole.
lines.zh: : 那我就继续亲你吧，如果可以的话。这是到目前为止我最接近让你幸福的方式。不过，那到底是真的因为{i}我{/i}，还是只是因为那个神秘的洞，还有待观察。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers22
: Right! The hole! I have hole-related news for you!
lines.zh: : 对了！那个洞！我有跟洞有关的消息要告诉你！

lines.en: : May I burden you once more with my incessant annoyances, Sensei? I promise it will be the last time until approximately five minutes from now when I inevitably do it again.
lines.zh: : 我能再拿我这些没完没了的烦人事来叨扰你一次吗，Sensei？我保证这是最后一次，直到大约五分钟后我不可避免地再来一次。

lines.en: : Sure. It’ll be nice getting hole-related news that doesn’t involve a girl’s medical records or the damage I inflicted upon her.
lines.zh: : 当然。能听到跟洞有关的消息、却不牵扯某个女孩的病历或者我对她造成的伤害，感觉还不错。

lines.en: : RIP Miku. Just not really because {i}she{/i} is involved with this news as well!
lines.zh: : 安息吧 Miku。不过也不完全是，因为这次的消息也有{i}她{/i}的份！

lines.en: : Oh no. Did the wounds reopen?
lines.zh: : 哦不。伤口又裂开了？

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers23
: Gross! But no. Uta, Miku and I made plans to go spelunking again this weekend so they can finally see it. And I was wondering if you would want to come as well?
lines.zh: : 恶心！不过不是。Uta、Miku 和我计划这个周末再去一次洞穴探险，好让她们终于能亲眼看看。而我想问你要不要也一起？

lines.en: : Has Miku finally annoyed you to the point where you feel the need to throw her down a bottomless pit?
lines.zh: : Miku 终于把你烦到觉得有必要把她扔进无底洞了吗？

lines.en: : No, but I can’t guarantee that isn’t what Uta and Miku plan to do with me once we get there.
lines.zh: : 不，但我不能保证到了那儿之后，Uta 和 Miku 不会对我做同样的事。

lines.en: : So you want me to come and act as your bodyguard or something?
lines.zh: : 所以你想让我一起去，好当你的保镖什么的？

lines.en: : Or so I can say goodbye while falling to my death. Whichever one winds up feeling right, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者好让我在坠落致死的时候能跟你道个别。看哪个到时候感觉更对吧，我猜。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, what do you hope to find down there?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇，你希望在那下面找到什么？

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers24
: I don’t know. Hole stuff? It’s just cool. I want to go look at the cool thing again. And you’re cool too, so I want you to go look at the cool thing with me. I think that’d be cool.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。洞里的东西？它就是很酷。我想再去看看那个很酷的东西。而且你也很酷，所以我想让你跟我一起去看那个很酷的东西。我觉得那样会很酷。

lines.en: : Cool.
scene iosenseiothers25
: Right?!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！

lines.en: : Any chance I could bring someone else along if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 如果我答应，能带别人一起去吗？

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers26
: Uhh...who? Because you know I don’t like a good 90%% of the class. But if there’s someone you know who just...really likes tunnels for some reason-
lines.zh: : 呃……谁？你知道我不喜欢班里大概 90%% 的人。不过要是你认识的哪个人就是……特别喜欢隧道之类的——

lines.en: : It’s not like that. I just...well, let’s say I’m part of a club. Like an...{i}occult{/i} club, I guess. That investigates the mysteries of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 不是那样。我只是……好吧，就说我是某个社团的一员。像是一个……{i}神秘学{/i}研究社之类的吧。调查 Kumon-mi 的各种谜团。

lines.en: : Why are you fucking with me? Just turn down the invitation if you don’t want to come. I promise I’ll only dwell on it until something else bad happens.
lines.zh: : 你为什么要耍我？不想来就直接拒绝邀请好了。我保证我只会纠结到下一件坏事发生为止。

lines.en: : I’m only partially fucking with you, Io. And even that’s just because the truth would sound even more ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 我只有一部分是在耍你，Io。而就连那一部分，也只是因为真相听起来会更荒唐。

lines.en: : This “club” of yours then — who’s in it?
lines.zh: : 那你这个「社团」——都有谁？

lines.en: : Makoto and Ayane are the two I’d want to bring. But if Maya, Yumi, and Nodoka could also come-
lines.zh: : Makoto 和 Ayane 是我想带上的两个。不过如果 Maya、Yumi 和 Nodoka 也能来——

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers27
: You’re turning this into an entire adventuring party. I was willing to compromise with {i}maybe{/i} one, but I’d rather just stay behind entirely if you’re bringing that many.
lines.zh: : 你这是要把它变成一整支冒险小队。带{i}一个{/i}我还愿意妥协，要是带那么多，我宁可干脆留下不去了。

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t {i}have{/i} to. I was just thinking it might be a good place for our next, uhh...club meeting?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我也不{i}一定要{/i}带。我只是在想那也许是下次，呃……社团活动的好地方？

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers28
: On second thought, just forget I said anything.
lines.zh: : 再想想，就当我什么都没说。

lines.en: : Io, I-
lines.zh: : Io，我——

lines.en: : No, it’s fine, Sensei. Really. Now that I think about it, dragging you along when Uta and Miku are going to be there is practically {i}asking{/i} for them to just not focus at all in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不，没关系的，Sensei。真的。现在想想，既然 Uta 和 Miku 都要去，硬把你拉上，简直就是在{i}要求{/i}她们从一开始就没法专心。

lines.en: : I mean, if “focus” is what you want out of your partners, you picked probably the two worst girls I can think of.
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果「专心」是你要从同伴身上得到的东西，那你大概挑了我能想到的最糟的两个女生。

lines.en: : I know. But that gets like ten times worse once {i}you’re{/i} factored in as well, so...
lines.zh: : 我知道。可一旦把{i}你{/i}也算进去，那就得再糟上十倍，所以……

lines.en: : Maybe we can go on another trip later on. Once I figure out more. Where I allow you to bring {i}one{/i} of your “clubmates.”
lines.zh: : 也许我们以后可以再去一趟。等我弄明白更多事情之后。到了那时候，我允许你带上{i}一个{/i}你的「社员」。

lines.en: : Then, I’ll talk to Ayane about-
lines.zh: : 那我就去跟 Ayane 说说——

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers29
: Makoto. Not Ayane.
lines.zh: : Makoto。不是 Ayane。

lines.en: : She’s the one I can tolerate the most out of that group. You bring Nodoka anywhere near me and I can promise you she’s going in the hole.
lines.zh: : 那一群里她是我最能忍受的一个。你要是让 Nodoka 靠近我，我可以保证她会进那个洞里。

lines.en: : Okay...Makoto it is then. But be careful, okay? That tunnel was huge and I don’t want you girls getting lost down there.
lines.zh: : 好……那就 Makoto 吧。不过要小心，好吗？那条隧道很大，我可不想你们几个女孩在里面走丢。

lines.en: : We’ll be fine, I promise. I’ve gone down a few times on my own since you and I found it and I haven’t gotten lost once.
lines.zh: : 我们会没事的，我保证。自从你和我发现它之后，我自己下去过好几次，一次都没迷路。

lines.en: : Famous last words, Io. You’ve basically just sealed your fate. This will be the last talk we ever have.
lines.zh: : 经典的遗言啊，Io。你基本上已经把自己的命运钉死了。这会是我们最后一次对话了。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers30
: Why have it {i}here{/i} when there’s an entire bath completely vacant then? That’s a much more relaxing place to close the chapter on my existence, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 既然有一整个完全空着的浴池，为什么要在{i}这儿{/i}谈？那才是为我的存在画上句号的更放松的地方，不是吗？

lines.en: : Probably because you hate all forms of nudity and have only been roped into this job out of necessity for shelter and money.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你讨厌一切形式的裸体，而且只是出于栖身和赚钱的需要才被卷进这份工作的。

lines.en: : Does just no one remember swimsuits exist? Obviously I’m not going to get naked. I have to wait until all the other girls leave to even use the locker room at school.
lines.zh: : 就没有人记得泳衣的存在吗？我显然不会脱光啊。在学校我甚至得等其他女生都走了才敢用更衣室。

lines.en: : Your existence makes me so sad. I’m not taking a bath with a swimsuit on, though.
lines.zh: : 你的存在让我好难过。不过我才不要穿着泳衣泡澡。

lines.en: : That just means you’re human, I think. Also, that’s fine. I’ve seen your penis plenty of times, remember?
lines.zh: : 那只是说明你是人类吧，我觉得。而且没关系。你的鸡巴我见过好多次了，记得吗？

lines.en: if iosex == True:
: Even up close once! But that, just like my living situation, was also out of necessity.
lines.zh: : 有一次还近距离看过！不过那跟我眼下的居住状况一样，也是出于需要。

lines.en: : Okay, hold on. That was-
lines.zh: : 好，等等。那次是——

lines.en: : Something neither one of us looks back on fondly, right? Which means it won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 我们俩谁回想起来都不太愉快的事，对吧？那意味着它不会再发生了。

lines.en: : Well...yeah. I wouldn’t want to put you through that again. But I also wouldn’t want to evoke any bad memories by putting you in a similar situation.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。我不想再让你经历一次。但我也不想把你放进类似的情境里，勾起什么不好的回忆。

lines.en: : You’re in luck then! Because I have so many terrible memories that having sex with you is almost a {i}good{/i} one by comparison!
lines.zh: : 那你走运了！因为我的糟糕记忆实在太多了，相比之下跟你做爱几乎都算得上是{i}美好{/i}的了！

lines.en: : Again, your existence makes me so extremely sad.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你的存在让我难过到了极点。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers31
: Come on. I’ll wash your back for you. I was about to close up shop anyway. The girls in the women’s bath can let themselves out.
lines.zh: : 来吧。我帮你搓背。反正我也准备打烊了。女浴池里的姑娘们会自己出去的。

lines.en: : I don’t know...it still seems like a bad idea. Especially when I already had to stop you from venturing out of your comfort zone the last time you brought a game to my house.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……这听起来还是个坏主意。尤其是上回你把游戏带到我家的时候，我就已经不得不阻止你踏出舒适区了。

lines.en: : Are you going to walk on eggshells around me forever now then? Is that what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 那你是打算永远在我身边如履薄冰吗？现在是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Is it really “walking on eggshells” to not let a girl who was sexually abused put her hands all over the naked body of an adult man?
lines.zh: : 不让一个遭受过性侵的女孩把手放到一个成年男人的裸体上，真的算「如履薄冰」吗？

lines.en: : No. Just cowardice and a little self-distrust is all.
lines.zh: : 不算。那只是怯懦，外加一点点自我怀疑罢了。

lines.en: : Why are you being pushy about this? Isn’t this something we should be a little more careful about if we want to keep things normal?
lines.zh: : 你为什么在这件事上这么咄咄逼人？如果我们想让一切保持正常，这事不是应该更谨慎一点吗？

lines.en: : Yes and no. I don’t want to be normal. Normal is boring.
lines.zh: : 是也不是。我不想正常。正常很无聊。

lines.en: : But at the same time, it hurts being turned down. And I can’t {i}not{/i} convince myself it’s because you’re disgusted by me. Are you?
lines.zh: : 但与此同时，被拒绝很疼。我没法{i}不{/i}让自己认定那是因为你嫌我恶心。是吗？

lines.en: : Of {i}course{/i} not. But I...
lines.zh: : {i}当然{/i}不是。可是我……

lines.en: : You what? Finish your sentence.
lines.zh: : 你什么？把话说完。

lines.en: : I don’t want to become like the people who made us into who we are today.
lines.zh: : 我不想变成那些把我们塑造成今天这样的人。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers32
: Oh, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei……

lines.en: : You already {i}have.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}已经{/i}变成了。

lines.en: $ iospring6 = True
$ io_love += 1
jump iospring7
else:
: I sure do. But a personal mission of mine is to prevent you from ever being close enough to touch it, and that is the exact situation you are asking me to partake in right now.
lines.zh: : 我确实变了。但我给自己定的一个使命，是让你永远别近到能碰到它，而你现在邀请我参与的，恰恰就是那样的处境。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers29
: I’d be really offended by that if I wasn’t so averse to sexual contact.
lines.zh: : 如果不是我对性接触这么排斥，我会因为这句话感到很受伤的。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : Actually, strike that. I {i}am{/i} still offended. You think I’m monochromatic after all, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 等等，收回那句。我{i}还是{/i}很受伤。你终究还是觉得我是单色的，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t. I think you’re insanely cute and that it would be hard for me to control myself in the scenario you’re inviting me to.
lines.zh: : 我没有。我觉得你可爱得要命，而在你邀请我的那个场景里，我很难控制住自己。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers32
: You controlled yourself when I was throwing myself at you, though. Wouldn’t that be harder?
lines.zh: : 可我往你身上扑的时候，你控制住了啊。那不是更难吗？

lines.en: : No, because the Io who was throwing herself at me looked nothing like the Io in front of me now. And it’s harder to not want you when you don’t look like you’re dying.
lines.zh: : 不，因为当时往我身上扑的那个 Io，跟现在站在我面前的这个 Io 完全不一样。当你的样子不像快死了的时候，我更难不去想要你。

lines.en: : How do you keep doing this?
lines.zh: : 你怎么总是能这样？

lines.en: : Doing...what? What did I do this time?
lines.zh: : 这样……怎样？这次我又做了什么？

lines.en: : Making me fall deeper in love with you.
lines.zh: : 让我越来越深地爱上你。

lines.en: : You really care about me...You’re not just faking it.
lines.zh: : 你是真的在乎我……你不是在装。

lines.en: : There’s nothing I can give you in return, though. You won’t let me.
lines.zh: : 可我没有什么能回报你的。是你不让我给。

lines.en: : I will if you figure something out to give me. I don’t want this, though.
lines.zh: : 你要是能想出点什么给我，我就让你给。不过我不要这个。

lines.en: : It’s just a bath, Sensei. I’m not telling you to destroy me this time. I just want to wash your back.
lines.zh: : 只是洗澡而已，Sensei。这次我又不是在叫你摧毁我。我只是想帮你搓背。

lines.en: : I can reach my own back, Io. But thank you for the offer.
lines.zh: : 我够得到自己的背，Io。不过谢谢你的好意。

lines.en: scene iosenseiothers33
: Can you at least kiss me again before leaving then? It’ll prevent me from having to throw myself over the counter to reach you.
lines.zh: : 那你走之前至少能再亲我一次吗？免得我得翻过柜台才能够到你。

lines.en: scene black
: {i}Hah...{/i}Yes, Io.
: I can kiss you again before leaving...
lines.zh: : 我可以在走之前再亲你一次……
